setup: Compile and reflect payloadless and typed workflow-event contracts with a positive explicit EventContractVersion.
assertion: Descriptor identity is stable name plus positive version, generic descriptors hide the base property legally, and no CLR-name or attribute identity participates.
expectedRed: The product still exposes EventName and WorkflowEvent envelopes instead of versioned descriptors.

setup: Reflect resumed EventEnvelope construction, properties, and typed payload materialization.
assertion: The runtime-created envelope carries WorkflowEventContract as EventContract and GetPayload requires the matching WorkflowEventContract<TPayload> descriptor.
expectedRed: EventEnvelope still carries EventName and exposes unchecked parameterless GetPayload<TPayload>().

setup: Reflect all selected root, nested, branch, item, and leased builder families and compile payloadless/typed waits with and without timeout.
assertion: Exactly twelve sequential families expose exactly four descriptor-based Wait overloads and no EventName-only overload remains.
expectedRed: Existing waits accept EventName and do not expose the four descriptor overloads.

setup: Construct direct, correlation, definition-fanout, and exact-definition start-or-deliver routes.
assertion: WorkflowEventRoute is closed to those four cases and StartOrDeliver carries distinct definition version, start idempotency key, and workflow input.
expectedRed: The product still exposes two caller-selected delivery methods and no route union.

setup: Compile and reflect payloadless and typed inbound events carrying contract, event/correlation/causation identities, occurrence time, route, and typed payload.
assertion: Both envelopes are immutable application values and the typed envelope exposes the matching typed contract and payload.

setup: Reflect and exhaustively match acceptance and rejection result cases.
assertion: Acceptance is exactly Accepted, Duplicate, or Rejected; rejection is exactly EventConflict, DirectInstanceNotFound, DirectInstanceTerminal, StartConflict, or FanoutLimitExceeded.
expectedRed: The current delivery status model includes NoActiveWait and lacks the acknowledgement-safe unions.

setup: Compile and reflect callback-facing durable ingress.
assertion: OrcaCore.Durable.Hosting.IWorkflowEventIngress exposes exactly payloadless and typed AcceptAsync overloads and no ephemeral ingress/client facade exists.
expectedRed: The product exposes IWorkflowEventClient instead of durable self-routing ingress.

setup: Reflect every durable and ephemeral builder and compile payloadless/typed publishes.
assertion: Exactly eight durable sequential root/nested/branch/item/leased families expose exactly two Publish overloads; every ephemeral, completion, and join family exposes none.

setup: Compile and reflect the outbound event, dispatcher, dispatch failure, and closed result union.
assertion: The application dispatcher exposes only DispatchAsync over WorkflowOutboundEvent, with no provider write, continuation, stream, or broker SDK type in its signatures.
expectedRed: The application-shaped dispatcher and outbound projection are absent.

setup: Build resultless/resultful ephemeral and durable definitions and inspect their Reference values.
assertion: Exactly four state-opaque reference families carry mode, definition id/version, and fingerprint.
expectedRed: Only durable references exist and definitions do not expose all four exact references.

setup: Resolve each of the four reference families through an already populated IWorkflowDefinitionRegistry.
assertion: Exactly four GetRequiredHandle overloads return the matching typed handle and missing or stale identity throws WorkflowDefinitionNotRegisteredException carrying the requested definition id, version, and fingerprint.

setup: Stage resultless/resultful definitions through the builder returned by each engine registration entry.
assertion: Each mode-specific engine builder exposes exactly two own-mode AddWorkflow overloads, stages atomically, and callback-only ingress exposes neither catalog builder nor registry.
expectedRed: Engine registration returns IServiceCollection and no explicit mode-specific catalog builders exist.

setup: Restart a durable catalog built from a fixed application DefinitionId and scan source, metadata, and public signatures.
assertion: Catalog identity is stable across restarts; no catalog composition calls DefinitionId.New; no workflow/signal discovery attributes, assembly scanning, provider records, or runtime protocol records leak into application event surfaces.
expectedRed: The old event client remains and the final catalog source does not exist.
